audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer reads Skill / Diana / Diana / Skill / Diana / Skill / Veigar while content win[] and packet.levelChart both read Diana on all seven rows, at 51.32% over 1479 games. Row 6 is the worst of it: the side says Veigar while the why under it describes Diana diving the back line.
audit.why: Veigar has no dash, blink or gap-closer; his only defensive tool is Event Horizon at 20s rank 1. Diana's 900 Q into an 825 Lunar Rush and a 475 Moonfall beats that at every stage, and the page's own late-game why already says so.
audit.corrected: Move rows 0, 3, 5 and 6 onto Diana so the full layer matches the content layer and the packet.

audit.why: Level 3 Q-E-Q all-in, level 6 Moonfall closing the last of the gap, first item before his scaling arrives, and a late game where Primordial Burst (120s rank 1) executes off missing health. The content spikes match the kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no digit in it, and winCon says to "dash the silence" — Veigar has no silence anywhere in his kit.
audit.why: The whole matchup is one number: Event Horizon at 20s rank 1. Baleful Strike is 6s, Primordial Burst 120s, and Dark Matter has no fixed cooldown of its own — Phenomenal Evil stacks shorten it, which is why denying his stacking matters.
audit.corrected: Rewrite breakdown.cooldowns around the 20s cage window plus the 6s and 120s, and remove the invented silence from winCon and report[1].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: content early and wants.you[2] both talk about him farming "Dark Matter stacks". Dark Matter does not stack.
audit.why: Riot's text: Baleful Strike permanently grants ability power for units it kills, and Phenomenal Evil stacks reduce Dark Matter's cooldown. The ability the reader must deny is Baleful Strike.
audit.corrected: Both strings renamed to Baleful Strike.

edits.before: Absorb the burst, dash the silence, and pull the conclusion. Shorthand: Event Horizon (Cage) down, wave right, go.
edits.after: Absorb the burst, bait the cage, and pull the conclusion. Shorthand: Event Horizon down for 20s, wave right, go.

edits.before: - Veigar Event Horizon (Cage): matchup-defining — Only the cage EDGE stuns — hold position near the center or leave before it forms; never dash into the wall. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Pale Cascade has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Event Horizon is 20s at rank 1 and only the cage EDGE stuns — hold near the centre or leave before it forms, and never Lunar Rush through the wall. That 20s is your whole all-in window. - Baleful Strike is 6s. - Primordial Burst is 120s and scales off your missing health.

edits.before: Q through the wave onto his chest, E the mark, three-hit string, walk — the phase trade he answers after you've left.
edits.after: Event Horizon is 20s at rank 1 — the moment the cage fades or he misplaces it, Q-mark and Lunar Rush straight in.

edits.before: Dashing onto an unmarked target with W down — Diana without the reset or the shield is a melee mage donating proximity.
edits.after: Unmarked, Lunar Rush is a 22-second dash that ends inside cage range — land the crescent first or do not go at all.

edits.before: Veigar wins by landing Event Horizon (Cage), denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Veigar wins by caging you on the way in, dropping Dark Matter onto the stun, and executing you with Primordial Burst.

edits.before: First item onward, chain the phases: mark-dash the contacts, R the river clumps, and reset through whatever groups.
edits.after: Punish the 20s cage window: shove, threaten, and make him spend Event Horizon defensively before your jungler arrives.

edits.before: Carry through the dive — mark, dash, pull, delete; your R turns their teamfight spacing into a suggestion.
edits.after: Carry by baiting the cage — with no dash and no blink, a Veigar who has spent Event Horizon is a free kill.

edits.before: Deny his Dark Matter stacking farm by shoving early
edits.after: Deny his Baleful Strike stacking by shoving early

edits.before: Veigar has no dash, no blink, no gap closer of any kind, which makes him one of the easiest champions in the game for you to run down once you hit level 3. His only real defensive tool is Event Horizon, and if he uses it early or misplaces the cage, he's dead to your dive. Punish him hard for any push attempt and don't let him free-farm Dark Matter stacks uncontested.
edits.after: Veigar has no dash, no blink, no gap closer of any kind, which makes him one of the easiest champions in the game for you to run down once you hit level 3. His only real defensive tool is Event Horizon at 20s, and if he uses it early or misplaces the cage, he's dead to your dive. Punish any push attempt and don't let him free-farm Baleful Strike uncontested.

notes: Chart: full layer read Skill/Diana/Diana/Skill/Diana/Skill/Veigar; content win[] and packet.levelChart are both all-Diana. I moved rows 0, 3, 5 and 6 onto Diana, so there is NO paired win[N] edit — win[N] is already Diana on every row and an edit whose before equals its after cannot be written. Row 6 was the dangerous one: the side said Veigar while the why under it described Diana diving their carry and resetting out, which is the exact self-contradiction the chart rule exists to stop. The whys on all four moved rows already read as Diana wins, so nothing needed rewriting to match. 'dash the silence' appeared in winCon and report[1].t — Veigar has no silence; removed from both. 'Dark Matter stacks' is a mechanic that does not exist: Baleful Strike grants the permanent AP and Phenomenal Evil stacks shorten Dark Matter's cooldown. packet.suspectNames flagged spikes[1].text 'Event Horizon's' — FALSE POSITIVE, that is the correct name with a possessive; left alone.
